text:
alex: Nightly eval alert for quant-v2-qat — 12/100 prompts failed function-call JSON schema validation, run id 8921. cc @maya @ryan :eyes:
nightly-evals-bot: Summary for run 8921: 12 failures, 3 unique schema errors (stringified arrays, numeric-as-string, unexpected extra fields). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/8921
alex: Pasted one failing sample from the validator:
```json
{"emit_candidate": {"candidates": "[{\"id\": \"c1\", \"score\": \"0.92\"}]", "kv_snapshot": "{\"last_key\": \"0xabc\"}", "confidence": "0.92", "extra_flag": "legacy"}}
```
maya: ugh, looks like inner JSON got stringified for both candidates and kv_snapshot, and numeric fields turned into strings. Could be postproc or model started emitting literal quotes.
ryan: Is this only happening on quant-v2-qat? Any diffs vs float baseline?
alex: float baseline (v2) had 0 fails on this prompt set. Failures spike only on quant-v2-qat and quant-v2-compat.
sophie: quick guess: a recent compile/pass added a safe-serialize step that JSON-encodes some dicts to avoid non-utf8, and quantization changed tokenization so model started emitting additional quotes.
maya: repro command I used locally: `./scripts/repro_eval.sh --model quant-v2-qat --run 8921 --prompt-id 47 --seed 42` — I can repro the same output.
ryan: Schema validator error excerpt:
```
ValidationError: At $.emit_candidate.candidates: expected array, got string
ValidationError: At $.emit_candidate.confidence: expected number, got string
```
maya: short-term mitigation: add a sanitizer in eval harness to `try: json.loads(field) if isinstance(field, str) and field.strip().startswith(('{','['))` before validating. But we should fix the root cause.
alex: prefer fix in runtime/generation parsing: the function-call handler should attempt to parse JSON-like strings produced by the model before handing to downstream code. That prevents production callers from seeing broken types.
ryan: I'll triage runtime PRs from the last week — suspect change `runtime/postprocess: safe_json_encode` by @jlee. If it's producing double-encoding we can revert or patch.
maya: created issue #2145: "quant-v2-qat: model emits stringified JSON in function outputs" and assigned to @ryan.
alex: For immediate regression gating: add a unit test that rejects any function output where array fields are strings. Put it into nightly-evals so future quant bring-ups fail fast.
ryan: Plan: 1) add parse-and-coerce step in eval harness (hotfix) 2) reproduce & bisect runtime change 3) add regression test to nightly (PR in ~2h).
sophie: Also check KV-cache scrubber: the `kv_snapshot` field being stringified might be coming from `kv-cache:serialize_snapshot` path. If that's doing `json.dumps` earlier than we expect, it explains both fields.
alex: Good call. @sophie can you grep the compile/runtime commits for `serialize_snapshot` changes?
sophie: on it. quick grep shows commit f6b3b5 touched kv snapshot encode in `runtime/kv_cache.py` — opening PR now.
maya: for the eval dashboard, I've annotated the failing prompts and pinned one example in the run UI (run 8921, prompt 47) to help QA.
nightly-evals-bot: Added regression label `schema-type-drift` to run 8921 and notified eng-ml on-call.
alex: If we decide to hotfix harness, we'll need a short canary rollout. deploy-bot: schedule canary?
deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: hotfix branch `fix/eval-parse-coerce` -> canary group 3/5 starting in 10m. I'll post status when done.
ryan: I'll pick up the issue, pushing a WIP PR to handle both stringified arrays and numeric strings. Will post link shortly.
maya: thanks — after the hotfix I'll re-run the nightly subset and post new summary.
alex: Thanks team. Keep threads short updates here, put PR links and test results.
ryan: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2318 (WIP) — includes parse fallback + unit tests.
maya: re-run after canary shows 0/100 fails on the subset. marking original run as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
